info.scriptSrcText: global gTileHeightListon beginSprite  delayCount = 0  gSeaFrame = 1  repeat with i = 1 to gTileHeightList.count    gTileHeightList[i] = random(50)  end repeatendon exitFrame  repeat with i = 1 to gTileHeightList.count    temp = gTileHeightList[i]    temp = temp * 0.94999999999999996    if temp < 1 then      temp = 0    end if    gTileHeightList[i] = temp  end repeatend
info.name: SeaBumph
